attacks.claim: Cross-Save links a Steam ID to an Epic account ID and stores this persistent cross-platform identifier, but the artifact applies an age restriction only to Epic under-13 (cabined) accounts. Steam accounts get no age check, so the backend may link and store identifiers for children with no documented parental consent or age gate.
attacks.evidence: "Epic under-13 (cabined) accounts get a restricted status from EOS; for them linking is not offered and the screen explains why." ABSENT: any age check, age gate, or parental-consent step for Steam-side linking or Steam accounts of under-13 players.
